answer: A quadratic staking curve forces each new validator to lock collateral proportional to the square of its rank, establishing a vertex where marginal cost spikes sharply. Quadratic slashing penalties scale super-linearly, so a Sybil cluster of size n incurs a burn rate of n^3, pushing the attack expense to its zenith well beyond any extractable reward. The resulting mesa of economic security is reached when total bonded stake exceeds the protocol's reward pool by a factor of 1.8, making profitable deviation mathematically impossible.
